==Description==
'''Reindeer Mech Yipee''' is an exclusive sticker obtained from [[The Final Act Event]]. It was obtained from Level 19 of the premium track, which had a cost of {{PlushieSnowman|575}} or {{Robux|98}} ({{Robux|78}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale) to unlock, with a total cost of {{PlushieSnowman|5,100}} or {{Robux|1,515}} ({{Robux|1,204}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale).

==Appearance==
'''Reindeer Mech Yipee''' showcases the {{Color|FinalAct|Reindeer Mech}} [[Hacker]] standing on all four. A robotic "''Yipee!''" can be heard when used.

==Trivia==
*This sticker is based on the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/tbh-autism-creature-yippee TBH/Yippee] meme.
